description:
## Goal

The react-vite template ships with a `ui/src/widgets.ts` and one example widget applied in a React component, so new scenarios start with the pattern and agents copying the template see it immediately.

## Expected Work

- Add `widgets.ts` with one example declaration.
- Add a matching React component using the typed `data-widget` attribute.
- README pointer at the `widget-authoring` skill.

## Acceptance

- A fresh scenario from the template passes the widget auditor rule out of the box.
name: widget-authoring-template-scaffolding
title: Add widget scaffolding to the react-vite scenario template
